title: 信息日报 2026-08-21

headline.title: Bun 1.4 发布：Simon Willison 展示如何用 Bun.WebView 构建 JSON API
headline.summary: Bun 1.4 正式发布，这是 Rust 重写后的首个稳定版本，修复了 2900 个 bug，并带来大量新功能，包括新的 Bun.WebView 接口。Simon Willison 撰文演示了如何利用 Bun.WebView 构建一个 shot-scraper 风格的 JSON API，展示了该接口的实际应用潜力。
headline.title_en: A shot-scraper-style JSON API on Bun 1.4's new Bun.WebView
headline.summary_en: Bun 1.4 has been officially released as the first stable version since the Rust rewrite, fixing 2,900 bugs and introducing a wide array of new features, including the new Bun.WebView API. Simon Willison demonstrates how to build a shot-scraper-style JSON API using Bun.WebView, showcasing the practical potential of this new interface.
headline.original_title: A shot-scraper-style JSON API on Bun 1.4's new Bun.WebView
headline.reason: Bun 1.4 是 JavaScript 生态中备受期待的里程碑版本，标志着 Rust 重写后的稳定化，对开发者影响巨大；西蒙的实操文章提供了新 API 的即时用例，具有很高的技术参考价值。
headline.reason_en: Bun 1.4 is a highly anticipated milestone in the JavaScript ecosystem, marking the stabilization after the Rust rewrite and significantly impacting developers; Simon's hands-on article offers an immediate use case for the new API, making it highly valuable as a technical reference.
